learning_objective: 🎯 Put on your engineer's hat and learn how simple tools and machines make heavy jobs super easy and fun to do!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A simple machine is a helpful tool with few or no moving parts. It helps us lift, push, or pull heavy things by using less force. Work becomes smart work!

main_concepts.concept_title: 🎡 The Magic of Wheels and Axles
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Imagine trying to push a heavy box on the ground versus putting it on a cart with wheels. Wheels roll easily and make moving heavy stuff feel like a breeze.
A seesaw in the playground is actually a giant lever! Using a sturdy stick resting on a point, you can easily lift things that are much heavier than you.

fun_activity.title: 🛝 Build a Mini Ramp
fun_activity.instructions: Take a hardcover book and lean it against a stack of smaller books to make an inclined plane (a ramp). Roll your toy cars down and see how gravity and the ramp make the car go super fast!

quick_recap: ⭐ Simple machines help us do heavy work using less energy and force.
⭐ Wheels, pulleys, and levers are tools we use every single day without realizing it.
⭐ Building your own simple machines is the first step to becoming an inventor!
